description: What a step says to one lead, built the way the send will build it: the templates filled in with the contact's fields, spintax at its first choice, then the mailbox's signature and the unsubscribe line. Left out, `contactId` is the campaign's first lead and `mailboxId` its first connected mailbox. `variantId` previews one of the step's variants instead of the step itself. `emptyVariables` lists the fields the step uses that this contact has no value for. They print nothing. The unsubscribe link is an example that unsubscribes nobody. `advice` reads this step's own words as this lead gets them, without the signature or the unsubscribe line, for what spam filters are known to weigh: an empty or all-capitals subject, `!!` or `?!`, spam words, more than 3 links, an empty or very long message, and images in place of text. `score` starts at 100 and loses points for each; the points are a starting guess nobody has measured against real inboxes, so read it as advice: it never stops a send. Each issue says where it is (`spans`, quoting the words). `wordsChecked` is false when the words don't read as English, Portuguese or Spanish, the only languages whose spam words we know: then finding none means nothing. Sends nothing and saves nothing.
